subject: Mutual Action Plan & stakeholder map — next steps (FinPay)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@finpay.com>, Alex Howard <alex.howard@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & stakeholder map — next steps (FinPay)

Hi Priya / Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same plan: 

Attendees: Priya Mehta (FinPay, Sponsor), Alex Howard (FinPay, Platform), Camila Reyes (Redwood AE), Marissa Cole (Redwood CSM), Dylan Brooks (Redwood Solutions)

Decision criteria (from call):
- Performance & predictable latency at pilot scale (P95 < 400ms)
- Cost per 1M tokens within FinPay internal threshold
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence, data retention policy confirmed
- Integration simplicity (prefix caching + API key management)

Economic buyer: Priya Mehta (confirmed on call)
Security/legal owner: TBD (please confirm)
Procurement contact: TBD (please confirm)

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestones:
1) Kickoff & scope confirmation — target: 2027-06-25 (owner: Camila)
2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence — target: 2027-06-28 (owner: FinPay legal / Redwood security)
3) Engineering kickoff & test data handoff — target: 2027-07-06 (owner: Dylan)
4) Pilot deployment (pilot window) — target: 2027-07-20 to 2027-08-03 (owner: FinPay engineering + Redwood)
5) Procurement/contract signature (DocuSign) — target: 2027-08-01 (owner: FinPay procurement + Redwood legal)

Attached: finpay-MAP-v1.pdf (draft MAP), stakeholder-map.xlsx (roles we captured during the call).

Ask: can you confirm the legal and procurement contacts (name + email) and whether the SOC2 evidence needs to be a redacted copy or if an internal downloadable Type II is acceptable?

I’ll update the MAP with confirmed owners once you reply. Proposed follow-up: security questionnaire walkthrough on 2027-06-28 at 11:00 PT — does that work?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

--

Thanks Camila — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming: I am the economic buyer and will own final approval. Our internal leads are:
- Legal: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finpay.com>
- Procurement: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@finpay.com>
- Platform/infra: Alex Howard (cc'd)

SOC2 note: we typically need a downloadable SOC2 Type II report (redacted is OK). Can Redwood provide either a hosted download link or a redacted PDF? Also want clarification on data retention and whether any PII will be sent to Redwood during pilot (we will provide anonymized test data).

The 06/28 security questionnaire walkthrough at 11:00 PT works for me.

Cheers,
Priya Mehta
